detailed_description: The Image Cropper lets you select an image, choose a free or preset aspect ratio, move the crop area, and set crop width or height values before generating a PNG preview. After cropping, the result can be downloaded as a PNG file. The tool is useful for quick browser-based crops of common image files, but it does not preserve original metadata, offer grid overlays, provide undo/redo history, or expose compression and output-format options.
usage_steps: Click the upload area and choose an image file from your device.
Choose Free, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9, or 9:16 as the aspect ratio.
Drag the crop selection to reposition it.
Adjust width or height values if you need a specific crop size.
Click Crop to generate the preview.
Click Download to save the cropped PNG.
usage_examples: Crop a profile photo to a square preview.
Prepare a 16:9 image crop for a presentation slide.
Create a vertical 9:16 crop from a wider source image.
Download a quick PNG crop for a documentation screenshot.
